settings.sandbox: temporary CODEX_HOME custom permission profile; only current task workspace writable, minimal system read, command network disabled
settings.approval: on-request in temporary CODEX_HOME config; no approval or sandbox bypass flags
settings.isolation: fresh task workspace; host CODEX_HOME and HOME are replaced; shell environment inherits none; candidate code separately runs in the network-disabled Docker sandbox
settings.network: provider requests use only the explicitly named dedicated API key from the execution environment; Codex sandbox commands and candidate code have no network
